set.body: Evidence: GpcaProblem.fit densifies covariance and feature cometric; joint rank-k exact sparse-functional fitting densifies data and both metrics below operator-shaped APIs. Acceptance: make dense exact-backend admission explicit at public fit boundaries; record realized materializations in diagnostics or provenance; reject strict no-dense policies before conversion; correct matrix-free documentation; test dense admission and rejection on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: Expose dense backend admission and realized materialization
